description: Legal/privacy NLP benchmark corpora used to evaluate the policy-to-knowledge extraction pipeline.

datasets.name: CUAD v1 — Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset
datasets.task: Clause extraction / span QA over 510 commercial contracts, 41 clause categories, 13k+ expert annotations.
datasets.citation: Hendrycks, D., Burns, C., Chen, A., & Ball, S. (2021). CUAD: An Expert-Annotated NLP Dataset for Legal Contract Review. NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks.

verified.contents: 510 contract PDFs, 510 plaintext contracts, 28 label-group XLSX, master_clauses.csv (83 cols x 510 rows), CUAD_v1.json (SQuAD 2.0 format, 510 docs / 20,910 QA pairs)

datasets.name: OPP-115 — Online Privacy Policies Corpus v1.0
datasets.license: Free for research use; citation required (Usable Privacy Policy Project)
datasets.task: Multi-label data-practice classification over 115 website privacy policies, 23k annotated practices in 10 categories.
datasets.citation: Wilson, S. et al. (2016). The Creation and Analysis of a Website Privacy Policy Corpus. ACL 2016.

verified.contents: 115 annotation CSVs, 115 sanitized HTML policies, original policies, pretty_print(+uniquified) renderings, consolidation at 0.5/0.75/1.0 overlap thresholds, documentation

datasets.name: ContractNLI — Document-level NLI for Contracts
datasets.task: Document-level natural language inference + evidence identification over 607 NDAs against 17 fixed hypotheses.
datasets.citation: Koreeda, Y., & Manning, C. D. (2021). ContractNLI: A Dataset for Document-level Natural Language Inference for Contracts. Findings of EMNLP 2021.

verified.contents: train.json (423 NDAs), dev.json (61), test.json (123) = 607 documents x 17 hypotheses; raw/ holds the 607 source documents

datasets.name: MAPP Corpus — Mobile App Privacy Policies (bilingual)
datasets.license: Free for research use; citation required (Usable Privacy Policy Project)
datasets.task: Bilingual (EN/DE) data-practice annotation over 64 English and 91 German mobile-app privacy policies.
datasets.citation: Arora, S. et al. (2022). A Tale of Two Regulatory Regimes: Creation and Analysis of a Bilingual Privacy Policy Corpus. LREC 2022.

verified.contents: 64 English + 91 German sanitized policies with matching English_consolidation / German_consolidation annotations, documentation
